_doc: One SHA-256 per cutscene of its timing record (CutsceneTimingRecord in tests/legacy/cutscene_timing_record.gd, tools/import/step_story.py timing_record): the length, whether it loops, every moment at which anything changes and every sound and event, in thousandths of a tick of the original's 73 Hz timer. It holds no tick: the original's cutscenes are its presentation and are not committed. Written by tools/import/godot/write_cutscene_timing.gd from the legacy pack, never by hand. The timelines of the legacy pack, the animations the scenes build from them (tests/legacy/test_cutscene_timing.gd) and the importer's own timelines (tools/import/test_story.py) must give these hashes. voyager_closing_* are the flight for the sub starting at window position (x, y) in cell c ('start').
